hooks.command: Read 0 - System/_cache.md for recent context. Then, read-only, check 7 - Wikipedia/raw/ and the Pending table of 7 - Wikipedia/raw/youtube_queue.md for sources that have no summary yet (the wiki-librarian skill's references/audit.md). If there are any, ask: 'There are X new files and Y pending videos — want me to summarize them?'. Do not run bulk linking, choose a name-collision winner, or modify notes. Also run `python3 "0 - System/scripts/embed_index.py" --check` — if it reports the semantic index is behind, offer to rebuild it (it is incremental and takes seconds).

Update 0 - System/_cache.md with a summary of what was done this session, which pages were touched, and any open questions. Then run `python3 "0 - System/scripts/trim_cache.py" 2` to keep only the 2 most recent sessions — older sessions are archived to _cache-archive.md automatically. Do NOT let _cache.md accumulate more than 2 sessions.
